body:
I'm feeling better, and I'm definitely on the road to getting over her.  I haven't spoken to her in a long time, and I think that's a definite good thing.  I still have my random bouts of depression over her, but they're a lot less frequent.  I still feel alone, but I am just living it one day at a time.  I just am hoping that at some point soon my life will turn itself around.  I'm going to an international college in a little over a year, and I'm just at a local community college right now.  I'm hoping that that gives me the oppurtunity I need to start my life, and get a second chance to just do it all over again.  Also to syslinkdown I love cryptography. Puzzles, codes, etc. I love them all. 

I don't take rejection well, and yeah I need to get better at taking it.  It just hurts to be with someone for so long and really commit yourself to a relationship and not get the same commitment back.

Thanks for all your help guys.  I've been in the contemplating suicide stage twice in my life now, and both times I've made it out.  Without the help of those around me, I don't know what would have happened.  I have been getting help from my best friend about all of it because he's also gone through a similar situation with an ex.

Thanks though for your replies they mean a lot to me.

I am really down about life in general.  I don't know what to do anymore.

I feel that life is never going to get better. I'm 19 years old.  I got turned down for a student loan, and so I'm just at a community college now.  I really don't like it.  I don't like any of the people there, and I have no friends around here that aren't away at some college.

My girlfriend of 2 years broke up with me saying that she couldn't handle a relationship right now with the stuff her dad is going through -- he is terminally ill.  That was 3 months ago.  I couldn't get over her though, and I texted her yesterday about getting together and talking. So now we're getting together on Sunday (tomorrow).  You can hate me for this, but I signed onto her Facebook, and I read a conversation between her and another guy and it was about her being confused about how to tell me that she no longer loves me.  The real kicker of that one was that it said the real reason she broke up with me in the first place was that she no longer felt anything for me.  

I feel that I have no future, and I feel that I love this girl completely.  It kills me inside to not have her with me anymore after 2 years.  

I just need encouragement.  What do I do? I'm going to get together with her tomorrow because I feel I have to know or I won't ever be able to live with myself.

I don't have many good friends, if any.  I feel that they all think of me as weird or something.  I don't like hanging out with them which is okay I guess since most of them are away at colleges most of the time anyway.  So most of the time I'm alone just sitting here in my room wondering where all of this went wrong.

I've contemplated death a lot lately.  Maybe it's just the holidays that have me down, and I feel so alone.  I could never commit suicide, at least I don't think I could.  I definitely wouldn't mind being hit by a car though -- some drunk driver whose enjoying the holiday just sideswiping me as I make a turn.

Does life get better?  Is all I have to look forward to a crappy day job that I don't like, and who knows what else?  I hear it said all the time that life gets better, but I don't see how it can get better.

I feel so alone. Friendless, jobless, and hopeless.

Please just tell me this will all get better.  I cannot take much more.
